title: 先买能直接炼钢的炉料
Buy furnace-ready feed
body:
先把正在做的拆船合同结算掉。再按 B 打开终端，进入交易行。

左边选「黑色炉料」，品质选「等级 1」。在卖家列表里挑一笔，买 1 吨就够试一炉。

先别买「未分选金属」来炼钢：那是另一条分选流程。

Finish the active salvage contract. Press B and open the exchange.

Choose Ferrous Feed, grade 1, and buy 1 tonne from a seller. Mixed Metal uses the separate sorting line.

title: 买好了，先等货到仓库
Wait for warehouse delivery
body:
付完钱，货还在路上，不是马上就能投进炉子。

打开「交付记录」，等这笔货显示「已收货」。下方的仓库炉料数量增加后，再去炉台。

贸易港要恢复营业，加工区也要完成基础修复。

Payment does not put feed in the furnace.

Open Deliveries and wait for Received. Check that stored feed has increased. Basic trade and processing facilities must be restored.

title: 去下方炉台，把买的料运过来
Bring your feed to the furnace
body:
关掉交易行。从船坞地板的右端绕下去，找到左侧的「炉体操作」，靠近按 E。

选好本炉要用的数量，点「把仓库炉料送到炉口」。机器人会从仓库把你买的料运过来。

这一步只是叫机器人送料，不是凭空生成材料。等原料到炉口，再开始装炉。

Close the exchange. Go around the right end of the berth floor and underneath. Use E at Furnace Control on the left.

Choose the charge size and click Bring Stored Feed to Furnace. The robot moves your owned stock; it does not create material. Wait for arrival.

title: 装炉，然后加热
Charge, then heat
body:
原料送到后，点「开始装炉」。

把加热功率调高，再点「设置功率」。快到 1640℃ 时降功率，尽量稳在 1640～1680℃，别一直满功率烧。超过 1710℃ 可能把成品烧成低等级。

温度够了还不能急着出钢：要等炉料全熔完，再测温取样。
After feed arrives, click Start Charging. Set heating power and apply it. Watch temperature and melting; reduce power near tapping temperature. The console explains what is still needed.

title: 测温取样，等探头收回，再出钢
Sample, retract, then tap
body:
炉料完全熔化、温度达到 1640℃ 后，点「测温取样」。

等测温探头完全收回，再点「倾炉出钢」。探头没收回、温度不够等情况，机器会拦住并提示原因。

这里用的是炉子的测温机构，不需要购买手持工具探针。

When the charge is melted and hot enough, take a temperature sample. Wait for the furnace probe to retract before tapping. The console explains any safety interlock. This is the furnace mechanism, not a purchased handheld probe.

title: 等钢坯冷却，再运回仓库
Cool and return the billets
body:
出钢后还要浇铸、冷却，然后把钢坯运回仓库。

在炉子里看见钢水，或看见刚浇好的钢坯，都不代表已经能卖。

等仓库里的合格钢坯数量增加，再安排交货。过热烧坏的低等级产品不能交给要求高等级的客户。
After tapping, wait for casting, cooling and transport back to storage. Visible molten steel or a fresh billet is not yet sellable warehouse stock. Check qualified billet stock before dispatch.

title: 把钢坯交给客户，收到货才收钱
Deliver the product and get paid
body:
回到交易行，打开「工业客户」。选一份需求，点「接下这笔订单」。

再选本次交货数量，点「从仓库发货」。只有自己仓库里符合等级的货才能发。

机器人把货送到客户处，客户收到后才付款。也可以用「自主挂单」给自己的库存定价出售。

Open Industrial Clients in the exchange and accept a demand. Choose a shipment quantity and click Ship From Warehouse. Only owned eligible stock can ship. Payment follows actual receipt. You may also list stock through Limit Orders.

title: 自己拆下来的外壳和龙骨，怎么算？
What about salvaged hull and keel?
body:
外壳、甲板、龙骨拆下来后是废料。完整设备走设备口，危险物走危险品口。

受托拆船是在替客户干活：交回东西后拿回收款，不会再把同一份料免费放进你的仓库。只有明确归公司的留料和买到的货，才是你的库存。

目前分选出来的料还是未评级原料，升级成合格炉料的流程尚未开放。现在练习炼钢，先用买来的等级 1 黑色炉料；不要把没做完的环节当成你漏找了入口。

Hull, decks and keel become scrap; whole equipment and hazards use their designated receivers. Commissioned salvage belongs to the client and pays a salvage fee. Only explicitly company-owned material and purchases become your stock.

Sorting currently produces unrated material. Certification into qualified feed is not available yet; use purchased grade 1 feed for steelmaking.

heat.idle: 下一步：选好数量，点「把仓库炉料送到炉口」。还没买料的话，先去交易行买等级 1 黑色炉料，并等它入库。
NEXT: choose a quantity and bring stored feed to the furnace. Buy grade 1 feed and await warehouse receipt first.
heat.transport: 下一步：等搬运车把料送到炉口，再按「通电熔化」。
NEXT: wait for the feed at the furnace, then strike the arcs.
heat.processing: 下一步：按「通电熔化」——炉盖合上、电极落下起弧，功率自动控制。化完、温度够了按「测温取样」，探头收回后按「倾炉出钢」。
NEXT: strike the arcs — the roof closes, the electrodes come down, power runs itself. Melted and hot: sample, then tap once the probe is up.
heat.returning: 下一步：等钢坯冷却并运回仓库。到库后再去交易行交货。
NEXT: wait for cooling and warehouse return before selling.
heat.complete: 这一炉已回仓。去交易行的「工业客户」安排交货。
THIS HEAT IS BACK IN STOCK. Arrange delivery under Industrial Clients.
heat.success: 已开始。看炉口和机器人，等原料送到后再装炉。
STARTED. Wait for the robot to bring feed before charging.
sort.send_feed: 把仓库废料送到分选机
market.purchase_success: 买好了。先等货到仓库，再去下方炉台按 E，点「把仓库炉料送到炉口」。
PURCHASED. Wait for warehouse receipt, then use E at the furnace and bring the stored feed over.
